annotations.title: What the Budget means for you

description: Every tax change already announced in a Budget for later tax years, run on their own figures: what each costs or saves them a year (savings and dividend tax rates, allowances, pensions counting for inheritance tax, the salary sacrifice NI cap), by the tax year it starts in, biggest first, and the rest listed with why it isn't run on their figures. The same list as their What the Budget Means for You page. Use for 'what changed for me in the last Budget', 'what does the Budget mean for me', 'how do the new tax rules affect me'.

band.description: Their income tax band, for the rate changes. Defaults to basic, as the page does.
